trigger: M11 2-AI consensus accepted Spatial LSI as productized-runner coverage but performance fail and required local generic runner-overhead reduction before more POD.

implementation.effect: Measured repeats can execute a lightweight hot-path callable while the full output payload is finalized exactly once after timing.

spatial_lsi_route_update.expected_effect: Avoid repeated M3 table and prepared-handle payload construction inside each measured repeat.

next_decision.recommended_review_question: Does M12 local overhead reduction justify one new focused POD rerun of the same Spatial LSI A/B, or is more local proof needed?

goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Reduce generic prepared-execution runner overhead locally using hot-repeat/finalize-once hooks.
goal_level_decision_audit.if_yes_what_actions_made_it_foolish: The foolish action would be to rerun POD before reducing the visible generic runner overhead.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_there_another_path: Yes: retarget another Set-A family, but M11 review warned that this could hide a real runtime cost behind heavier work.
goal_level_decision_audit.can_i_try_a_different_path_now: Yes: document the local reduction and request 2-AI review before any focused rerun.
